subject: POC milepost: acceptance criteria, blockers, and weekly MAP actions
messages:
From: Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@acmehealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Oct 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC planning — initial MAP and acceptance criteria

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team came away impressed with the latency profile and the KV cache demo. We're ready to formalize a short POC (3 weeks) to validate performance on our 3 canonical workloads and to lock acceptance criteria.

Attached is a rough MAP (MAP_acme_v1.xlsx) with proposed milestones: baseline ingest, model tuning evaluation, and production-like load test. Key acceptance items from our side:
- Functional: end-to-end inference for the three workflows (document extraction, clinical summarization, triage routing)
- Quality: QA pass rate >= 92% on our labeled sample sets (per workload)
- Performance: P99 latency < 200ms for 750-token prompts under steady-state 8 req/s; sustained throughput during load test >= 60 req/s
- Security/compliance: SOC2 evidence + data handling notes for PHI in test data (we will provide sanitized samples)

Our procurement team is going to need a draft SOW and billing plan before we can start — copying them here. Also flagging one potential blocker: our security team requires confirmation on log retention and whether inference traces contain user PII by default.

Can we set a recurring 30-minute weekly MAP checkpoint (Tuesdays preferred) to capture progress, owners, and blockers? If so, please send a recurring invite and a one-page checklist for the eval plan so our data team can prepare.

Best,
Alex
Alex Taylor
Director, Digital Transformation — Acme Health
alex.taylor@acmehealth.com
+1 415-555-0199

Attachment: MAP_acme_v1.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 26 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC planning — initial MAP and acceptance criteria

Alex — great to hear and glad the demo landed. Yes to the cadence: I propose a 30-minute weekly checkpoint on Tuesdays at 11:00 AM PT starting Nov 2. I've attached a short trial-eval-checklist that aligns with your acceptance bullets and separates owner-level tasks.

High level next steps from our side:
- We will populate the MAP with owners and timelines (Sean / Marissa)
- Pre-POC onboarding call (30 min) to confirm data delivery and sanitized sample set (Karthik to lead)
- Deliver SOW draft by Nov 1 for procurement review (Marissa to coordinate)

We will also produce a short observability runbook for the load test (what metrics we capture, dashboards). On the security question: we do not persist user PII in inference traces by default; we can provide a config summary and options for masking or reduced retention. I'll have Karthik prepare a note for your security team.

Proposed attendees on our recurring checkpoint: you + 2-3 of your data eng/ops; Sean, Marissa, Karthik, and Hannah (CS lead) from our side. Sending a calendar proposal shortly.

Thanks — will follow up with the MAP updated and the checklist attached.

Cheers,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai

Attachment: trial-eval-checklist.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 27 Oct 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Acme POC — owners and immediate asks

Team — quick internal note after Alex's MAP:

Summary of owners/tasks (to populate MAP):
- Marissa: Draft SOW + billing schedule (target Nov 1) — include trial-duration pricing and a contingency credit for SLA miss (negotiation point)
- Karthik: Lead onboarding call + produce observability runbook (metrics set: P95/P99, token cost breakdown, memory/KV hit rate)
- Hannah: CS checklist for data ingestion and sample labeling requirements; confirm scrubbed sample format for PHI handling
- Sean: Customer cadence, MAP checkpoint lead, contract escalation if procurement requests discounts

Known risk: procurement will push for a 60-day invoice term; we prefer 30-day — Marissa, can you draft language and fallback terms? Also, security will likely want explicit retention windows; Karthik, include the default retention and an option for shorter retention in the runbook.

I'll sync with Marissa today and share the MAP with Alex by end of day.

—Sean
From: Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@acmehealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Oct 2027 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC planning — initial MAP and acceptance criteria

Thanks Sean — this looks good. A couple of clarifications from our side before the onboarding call:

- Acceptance thresholds: the QA pass rate target is per-workflow and we will share the labeled sets by Nov 3. Expect separate baselines for Document Extraction (~1,800 items) and Summarization (~600 items).
- Security: procurement needs a short note on log retention and whether traces include redactable fields. Also need a copy of your SOC2 attestation and any encryption/KMS notes.
- Procurement blocker: we need a DRAFT SOW to review — even a redlineable PDF. We can't schedule the production-level load test until SOW is signed.

Procurement, if you have any immediate constraints (billing cadence, PO requirements), please flag them.

Alex
